notes.title: Wishlist Tiny Dangerous Dungeons Remake!
notes.content:
Tiny Dangerous Dungeons is being completely rebuilt from scratch with brand new graphics, music, and content. Featuring new and improved dungeon that is twice the size than in the original game, with new secrets, new items, new enemies, and ferocious new boss battles!

Check out the trailer:
